entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Vishal Panwar appearing on behalf of Advocate General
 Order

This is first application filed under Section 482 of BNSS seeking anticipatory bail, as the applicant/accused is apprehending her arrest in connection with FIR/Crime No.171/2024 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station - M.G. Road, District Indore (M.P.) for commission of offence punishable u/S 420, 467, 468, 471, 474, 120-B and 34 of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has not committed the offence and she has falsely been implicated in the case.
She is a lady aged about 31 years.

In this case, the main accused Aihatesham Khan, Bilkis Khan, Jahid Khan, Mohd Jakir, Abhay Singh Rathore, Rahul Vadera, Chetan, Rajkumar Salvi, Jagdish Chouksey, Bhupendra, Rameshwar Parmar, Uday Singh Bhadoriay, Sunil and Murlidhar have granted regular bail and co-accused Bilkis Khan has granted anticipatory bail.

It is also submitted that the applicant is also in implicated in five crime numbers and she has already NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-IND:12222 2 MCRC-18741-2025 been granted anticipatory bail in other crime numbers.
On these grounds prayer is made for grant of anticipatory bail to the applicant.
3. Learned Govt. Advocate has opposed the prayer but has fairly submitted that the applicant is enlarged in other crimes on anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: 4. Having considered the rival submission and after perusal of case diary so also considering other facts and circumstances of the case and in view of the orders of other co-ordinate bench wherein the applicant has granted anticipatory bail, this Court is of the view that applicant deserves to the enlarged on anticipatory bail hence, without commenting on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that in the event of arrest, applicant shall be released on bail upon her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
(Rupees One Lac Only) with two sureties of 50,000/- each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Arresting Officer for her appearance before the trial Court on all dates and for complying with the conditions enumerated in sub- section (2) of Section 482 of BNSS.
